mechanics.claim: The totem's nails deal magic damage and the execution deals separate raw (true) damage to already-marked targets below the threshold.
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|area damage}} with the nail and deals {{tip|raw damage}} to executed targets.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks the nail damage/mark but not the subsequent execution.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the nail from the totem but not the execute.

mechanics.claim: Successful executions refresh the mark duration on all other affected targets, extending the execute window.
mechanics.quote: Successful executions refresh the mark duration on all affected targets.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown begins on cast, not on totem landing or resolution.
